name: integration-doctor
description: Integration Doctor for DHL APIs: checks a DHL API request before you send it, and explains DHL's errors in plain language.

scripts.lint: npm run build -w @integration-doctor/rules && npm run lint --workspaces
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @integration-doctor/rules && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build -w @integration-doctor/rules && npm run test --workspaces
scripts.e2e: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.e2e.yaml up -d --build --wait && playwright test; status=$?; docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.e2e.yaml down; exit $status
